method: Each register is written a different legal value from its own declared domain and the result read back from a refresh dump. An echo on the written path is never waited for: the device answers a linked pair on the partner path and is silent on the one addressed. Passes are split by channel parity so a linked pair is never written against itself, writes are paced because a burst is dropped, and every register gets three attempts. Each pass restores what it wrote before the next begins.
